title: The first day
offscreen: Tell your child about your own first day of school, with something that was scary and how it went.

scenes.text: It's the first day. At the door your tummy feels tight.

options.label: I tell Mum or Dad
options.outcome: They tell you it's normal, and that your tummy loosens up once you go in.

options.label: I hold my cuddly toy tight
options.outcome: Your cuddly toy comes with you to the coat peg, then waits for you there.

options.label: I go in and see
options.outcome: Inside there's a teacher who says your name. She already knows you.

scenes.text: You don't know anyone in the class.

options.label: I watch what the others are doing
options.outcome: You see a child with building blocks. You go closer.

options.label: I tell someone my name
options.outcome: Her name is Sara. You sit next to each other.

options.label: I stay close to the teacher
options.outcome: The teacher takes you to a group and introduces you.

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
